notes: Cross-sectional survey of 286 rice farmers (Field Survey, 2024) in three Kano LGAs chosen for high concentration of SRI farmers. Only adoption drivers (logit Table 4, page 9) are extracted. No adoption rate is reported: the paper never says how many of the 286 adopted. SRI is defined by six principles (page 2) but the paper does not say which components farmers applied, so full sri bundle vs partial_bundle is unknown. Not extracted: Table 5 factor-analysis loadings of perceived constraints (household size, low net gain, etc.); these are perception loadings, not effect estimates on adoption (judgement call, flagged). Model fit: -2 Log likelihood 407.101, Chi-square 89.769, Pseudo R Square 0.283. No cost/return or carbon values.
